Vitamins and minerals support hair growth best when you have an underlying nutritional gap or deficiency.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lUmgXJ1cQNk&t=20)

### Key Vitamins and Minerals for Hair

- **Vitamin D:** Helps create new hair follicles and regulate the hair growth cycle. Low levels are commonly linked to hair thinning.[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/the-best-vitamins-supplements-and-products-for-healthier-hair)[[2]](https://www.conwaymedicalcenter.com/news/topic/do-hair-growth-vitamins-actually-work/)[[3]](https://www.hairclub.com/blog/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth/)
- **Iron (and Ferritin):** Carries oxygen to your red blood cells and hair roots. Iron deficiency is a leading nutritional cause of hair shedding, especially in women.[[1]](https://www.conwaymedicalcenter.com/news/topic/do-hair-growth-vitamins-actually-work/)[[2]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/the-best-vitamins-supplements-and-products-for-healthier-hair)[[3]](https://www.ulta.com/discover/beauty-education/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth)
- **Vitamin C:** Acts as an antioxidant and helps your body absorb iron from food and supplements. It also supports collagen production.[[1]](https://ishrs.org/patients/treatments-for-hair-loss/nutrition-and-vitamins/)[[2]](https://www.conwaymedicalcenter.com/news/topic/do-hair-growth-vitamins-actually-work/)[[3]](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/best-vitamins-hair-growth)
- **B-Vitamins & Biotin:** Biotin (Vitamin B7) helps with keratin synthesis. However, medical reviews note that biotin only helps if you are actually deficient , and high doses can skew lab tests like thyroid panels.[[1]](https://www.ulta.com/discover/beauty-education/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://www.conwaymedicalcenter.com/news/topic/do-hair-growth-vitamins-actually-work/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lUmgXJ1cQNk&t=20)
- **Zinc:** Supports tissue repair and hair follicle function.[[1]](https://www.goodrx.com/health-topic/dermatology/best-vitamins-for-hair-skin-and-nails)[[2]](https://www.ulta.com/discover/beauty-education/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth)

### Popular Multi-Ingredient Hair Supplements

- **Nutrafol:** A multi-ingredient nutraceutical that targets stress (ashwagandha), hormones (saw palmetto), and nutrition (zinc, selenium, vitamins C, D, and E).
- **Viviscal Hair Growth Supplement:** Combines a marine-derived protein complex (AminoMar) with biotin, zinc, vitamin C, and iron.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/best-vitamins-hair-growth)[[2]](https://www.rochesterregional.org/hub/hair-loss-treatment-nutrafol)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/AestheticDermCtr/videos/experiencing-hair-loss-and-not-sure-what-to-dowell-all-types-of-hair-loss-can-be/816162607314247/)[[4]](https://www.ulta.com/discover/beauty-education/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth)

### Important Safety Tips

- **Test First:** Taking vitamins you do not need will not speed up hair growth; your body simply flushes out excess water-soluble vitamins. Ask a doctor for a blood test (such as ferritin and vitamin D) before starting high-dose single supplements.
- **Watch for Overdose:** Too much Vitamin A or selenium can actually trigger hair loss.[[1]](https://www.hairclub.com/blog/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lUmgXJ1cQNk&t=20)[[3]](https://www.conwaymedicalcenter.com/news/topic/do-hair-growth-vitamins-actually-work/)

To help narrow down what might be going on, let me know:

- Are you experiencing **sudden shedding**, **gradual thinning** , or **slow growth**?
- Have you had any **bloodwork** done recently?
